title_en: Opinion of the Supreme People's Court on Supporting and Ensuring Guizhou's Efforts to Blaze a New Trail in the Western Development in the New Era
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Opinions on Supporting and Ensuring Guizhou's Pioneering New Paths in the Western Development in the New Era

Fa Fa [2022] No. 30

To deeply study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law, earnestly implement the spirit of General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech during his inspection of Guizhou, actively implement the Guiding Opinions of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the State Council on Promoting the Formation of a New Pattern of Western Development in the New Era and the Opinions of the State Council on Supporting Guizhou to Pioneer New Paths in the Western Development in the New Era, fully leverage the functions of the people's courts, and effectively support and ensure that Guizhou pioneers new paths in the western development in the new era, the following opinions are formulated based on the actual work of the people's courts.

I. Overall Requirements

1. Deeply understand the significant importance of supporting and ensuring Guizhou's pioneering new paths in the western development in the new era. Supporting Guizhou to pioneer new paths in the western development in the new era is an important deployment made by the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core to leverage Guizhou's comparative advantages, consolidate and expand the achievements of poverty alleviation, smooth domestic circulation and domestic-international dual circulation, and promote high-quality development. It is of great significance for promoting coordinated regional development and promoting the formation of a new pattern of western development in the new era. People's courts at all levels must effectively unify their thinking and actions with the Party Central Committee's decisions and deployments, profoundly understand the decisive significance of the "Two Establishments," enhance the "Four Consciousnesses," strengthen the "Four Confidences," achieve the "Two Upholds," continuously improve political judgment, political understanding, and political execution, consciously integrate into the overall work of the Party and the state, faithfully fulfill the duties conferred by the Constitution and laws, and provide high-quality judicial services and guarantees for Guizhou to pioneer new paths in the western development in the new era.

2. Precisely align with the goals and tasks of supporting and ensuring Guizhou's pioneering new paths in the western development in the new era. People's courts at all levels must adhere to a result-oriented approach, fully, accurately, and comprehensively implement the new development philosophy, comprehensively align with and precisely grasp Guizhou's judicial needs for pioneering new paths in the western development in the new era, closely focus on Guizhou's strategic positioning of "four zones and one highland," concentrate on judicial issues in key areas and key links such as social and economic development, poverty alleviation, and the ecological environment, strengthen investigation and research, innovate working mechanisms, and provide strong judicial support for Guizhou to pioneer new paths in the western development in the new era.

II. Service and Guarantee for Building a Comprehensive Reform Demonstration Zone for Western Development

3. Promote the market-oriented allocation reform of factors. Properly handle disputes arising from the market entry of rural collective operating construction land, and support the accelerated construction of a unified urban-rural construction land market with equal rights and prices, smooth circulation, and shared benefits. Adjudicate cases involving the conversion of rural resources into assets, funds into shares, and farmers into shareholders in accordance with the law, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of rural collective economic organizations and their members. Adjudicate disputes involving the transfer, lease, and mortgage of construction land use rights in accordance with the law, ensuring the standardized and efficient use of construction land. Adjudicate various cases involving mineral resource management in accordance with the law, correctly determine the validity of registered mining rights transfer contracts under the reform of the "net mine transfer" mechanism, and protect the orderly transfer of mining rights. Deepen the reform of enterprise bankruptcy reorganization, pre-reorganization, and conversion from enforcement to bankruptcy, promote the adjustment, revitalization, and disposal of existing assets of state-owned enterprises, and optimize the allocation of incremental capital.

4. Optimize the judicial guarantee mechanism for the business environment. Adhere to equal litigation status, equal application of law, and equal legal liability for all types of market entities, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of all types of market entities equally in accordance with the law. Properly handle cases involving enterprise margin trading and securities lending in accordance with the law, and improve the quality and efficiency of financial services to the real economy. Support and supervise administrative agencies in exercising their powers according to law, and assist administrative agencies in deepening reforms of streamlining administration, delegating power, strengthening regulation, and improving services, creating a fair and orderly market competition environment. Support Guizhou courts in accelerating integration into the construction of a creditworthy Guizhou, improve the system of credit supervision, warning, and punishment for dishonest judgment debtors, and improve mechanisms for credit promises, restoration, and objections by dishonest judgment debtors, and promote the accelerated improvement of the social credit system.

III. Service and Guarantee for Building a Demonstration Zone for Consolidating and Expanding the Achievements of Poverty Alleviation

5. Support the continuous promotion of development in former poverty-stricken areas. Punish criminal acts that undermine the order of agricultural production and operations, endanger the implementation and landing of central government policies benefiting farmers, and ensure the people's peace of mind in production and life. Establish a linkage mechanism between administrative law enforcement and judicial enforcement concerning the labor income of rural employed persons, strengthen the adjudication and enforcement of cases involving migrant workers' wages, flexible employment persons, labor remuneration in new employment forms, and work-related injury compensation disputes, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of vulnerable groups. Improve judicial aid mechanisms, improve diversified comprehensive aid models that connect judicial aid with social aid, adhere to the principle of granting aid whenever possible, and prevent litigation-induced poverty or return to poverty.

6. Serve rural revitalization. Continuously promote the normalization of the crackdown on organized crime and vice, and severely crack down on criminal acts that manipulate and control villagers' self-governing organizations and grassroots Party organizations, and that disrupt and forcibly undertake rural road construction, water supply guarantee projects, human settlement improvement projects, etc. Adjudicate cases involving domestic sewage, black and odorous water bodies, garbage pollution, and other livelihood-related matters in rural areas fairly and efficiently in accordance with the law, and promote the construction of beautiful villages. Adjudicate cases involving permanent basic farmland in accordance with the law, and strengthen the protection and quality improvement of cultivated land. Serve the strategy of strengthening agriculture through brands, increase protection of geographical indications and well-known brands of characteristic and advantageous agricultural products, and assist in the "export of Guizhou products."

IV. Service and Guarantee for Building a New Highland for the Inland Open Economy

7. Promote the upgrading and improvement of the inland open economy pilot zone. Adjudicate trade dispute cases involving the implementation of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement, digital trade, cross-regional or cross-border e-commerce, foreign trade, overseas warehouses, etc., in accordance with the law, and serve and ensure the liberalization and facilitation of trade and investment. Deepen regional judicial cooperation, improve judicial cooperation mechanisms with the Chengdu-Chongqing economic circle, the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the Yangtze River Economic Belt, etc., and strengthen cooperation and exchanges in case handling and legal policy research. Support Guizhou courts in serving and ensuring the construction of Liping, Congjiang, and Rongjiang in southeastern Guizhou as bridgeheads connecting with the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, the construction of Zunyi as a pioneer demonstration zone for integrating into the Chengdu-Chongqing dual-city economic circle, and the construction of the Tongzi (Chongqing) Industrial Park as a demonstration zone for undertaking industrial transfer from Sichuan and Chongqing.

8. Support the construction of Guizhou's internal and external opening channels. Properly handle various disputes arising from the construction of railways, expressways, waterways, airports, dry ports, and other related projects in accordance with the law, and provide strong judicial guarantees for the smooth operation of internal and external passenger and freight transport corridors. Support Guizhou courts in exploring specialized adjudication mechanisms for transport cases involving the China-Europe Railway Express, the New Western Land-Sea Corridor, etc., and serve the construction of national comprehensive transportation hubs in Guiyang and Zunyi.

V. Service and Guarantee for Building a Demonstration Zone for Digital Economy Development Innovation

9. Strengthen judicial protection of intellectual property rights. Properly handle disputes arising from the determination of ownership of scientific and technological achievements, transfer of rights, value determination, and benefit distribution, fully implement punitive damages for intellectual property infringement, and support the transformation, application, and industrialization of scientific and technological achievements in accordance with the law, assisting in the implementation of "introducing science and technology to Guizhou." Adjudicate cases involving new energy power batteries, new energy vehicle supporting industries, the development of the aerospace industry, new plant varieties, and the digital economy in accordance with the law, and support the cultivation and expansion of strategic emerging industries. Strengthen the judicial protection of intellectual property rights for characteristic food brands, authentic Chinese medicinal materials, and ethnic medicine, and promote the upgrading and improvement of traditional industries.

10. Protect the development of the digital industry in accordance with the law. Severely crack down on criminal activities endangering data security, illegal intrusion, destruction, and control of computer information systems, illegal use of information networks and big data, infringement of citizens' personal information, and other information network crimes, continuously strengthen the security guarantee for big data aggregation, and support Guizhou in building a national hub node for the integrated computing power network and creating a computing power guarantee base for the whole country. Adjudicate antitrust and unfair competition cases in the digital industry in accordance with the law, and promote the healthy development of the digital industry. Relying on the Guiyang Big Data Exchange, conduct research on judicial issues concerning data resourceification and capitalization reforms, with data rights confirmation rules, data trading rules, and benefit distribution rules as the core, and promote the orderly circulation of data elements.

VI. Service and Guarantee for Building a Pilot Zone for Ecological Civilization Construction

11. Strengthen judicial protection of the ecological environment. Severely punish criminal acts such as environmental pollution and ecological destruction in accordance with the law, and build a judicial protection barrier for ecological and environmental safety. Fully leverage the adjudication functions of environmental public interest litigation and ecological and environmental damage compensation litigation, and effectively safeguard social and public interests. Strengthen judicial protection of biodiversity, strictly implement the Yangtze River's "ten-year fishing ban," increase judicial support for the ecological protection and restoration of the Wujiang River, the North and South Panjiang Rivers, the Hongshui River, and the Qingshui River, and strengthen the construction of specialized protection patterns for world natural heritage sites, nature reserves, and important rivers, lakes, and wetlands. Properly handle disputes involving carbon emission allowances, certified voluntary emission reduction trading, carbon trading product guarantees, corporate environmental information disclosure, carbon-related green credit, and green finance, and assist in achieving the goals of "carbon peak" and "carbon neutrality."

12. Actively participate in the social governance of cultural ecology and natural ecological environment. Protect tangible cultural heritage and intangible cultural heritage in accordance with the law, and explore and improve the judicial protection mechanism for the continuation of human civilization, such as ethnic villages, traditional villages, historically and culturally famous villages, and traditional folk customs. Leveraging the advantages of the Environmental Protection Tribunal of the Qingzhen City People's Court of Guizhou Province in exercising centralized jurisdiction over environmental resources cases across administrative divisions, and leveraging the leading and exemplary role of the People's Court Environmental Resources Trial Practice (Qingzhen) Base, explore and innovate the adjudication system and mechanism for environmental resources. Deepen watershed and regional judicial cooperation and coordinated governance of the ecological environment, strengthen coordination and linkage between Guizhou courts and other courts in the watershed and other units, and build a multi-governance environmental governance system. Support Guizhou courts in hosting the Guiyang International Forum on Ecological Civilization - "Ecological Civilization Rule of Law Theme Forum," and create a national and international high-end platform for legal exchanges.

VII. Assist in Improving the Level of Ensuring and Improving People's Livelihood

13. Protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people in accordance with the law. Severely punish crimes such as homicide, robbery, kidnapping, trafficking and sexual assault of women and children, and endangering food and drug safety, and protect the personal and property safety of the people. Severely crack down on drug crimes, and resolutely curb the breeding and spread of drug crimes. Adjudicate and enforce cases in the fields of education, medical care, elderly care, childcare, and social security in accordance with the law, increase the protection of the rights and interests of college graduates and new industrial workers, and safeguard the fair employment rights of workers. Implement the positioning that "housing is for living, not for speculation," strengthen the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of housing consumers, and promote the healthy circulation and development of the real estate industry.

14. Improve the judicial guarantee mechanism for people's livelihood rights and interests. Strengthen the connection and coordination with relevant units, and promote the correct application of personal judicial protection orders, family education orders, etc. Improve the linkage mechanism with schools and communities, and strengthen judicial protection for left-behind children, empty nesters, and left-behind women. Explore the construction of a centralized jurisdiction mechanism for criminal, civil, and administrative cases involving minors, and increase judicial protection for minors. Explore the establishment of early warning, investigation, and mediation mechanisms for disputes involving the elderly, and serve the work on aging in the new era. Improve mechanisms related to transparent enforcement, standardized enforcement, and lawful, good-faith, and civil enforcement, improve enforcement oversight and constraint mechanisms, and strive to effectively solve the difficulties in enforcement.

VIII. Assist in Strengthening Security Guarantees and Risk Prevention in Key Areas

15. Ensure the safety of key industries and fields in accordance with the law. Severely crack down on organized crime and vice in industries and fields such as rural construction, new urbanization construction, open channel construction, cultural tourism, and mineral energy. Punish tax evasion, tax fraud, and other illegal and criminal acts that exploit the central government's tax incentives for Guizhou. Support the establishment of a joint meeting system for inter-provincial cases involving Guizhou local government debt, support the pilot work of reducing debt risk levels, and fully leverage multiple forces to steadily promote the lawful and proper resolution of local government debt. Establish communication and coordination mechanisms for major risk areas with relevant functional departments, serve the research, judgment, early warning, and handling of risks in key areas such as real estate property management, finance, and education and training, and earnestly prevent and control economic risks.

16. Actively carry out social conflict resolution work. Adhere to and develop the "Fengqiao experience" in the new era, comprehensively promote the entry of the people's court mediation platform into villages, communities, and grids, strengthen the connection with grassroots Party organizations, grassroots governance units, "five elders" personnel, grid members, etc., establish a comprehensive grassroots conflict prevention and resolution network covering the entire region, and promote the discovery, mediation, and resolution of grassroots conflicts on the spot. Adhere to putting non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms first, deepen the construction of a one-stop diversified dispute resolution and litigation service system with Chinese characteristics, improve the "court + society" diversified dispute resolution pattern under the leadership of the Party committee, leverage the online integration advantages of the people's court mediation platform, enhance the substantive dispute resolution capability of the litigation service center, and promote the source governance, diversified resolution, online mediation, and one-stop resolution of conflicts and disputes. Inherit and develop the "Ma Xiwu trial method," go deep into rural areas, communities, enterprises, and areas with inconvenient transportation, and provide high-quality judicial services to grassroots people.

IX. Safeguard Measures

17. Strengthen team building. Firmly adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work, adhere to the principle of building the team through Party building to promote adjudication, and promote the deep integration and mutual promotion of Party building and adjudication business work. Strengthen the construction of talent teams in important positions and key fields, and deeply promote the echelon training of adjudication business experts. Establish a counterpart support mechanism for education and training, organize the Supreme People's Court Western Lecturer Group to regularly conduct itinerant lectures in the western and ethnic regions, and conduct support lectures from time to time according to the education and training needs of Guizhou courts. Support Guizhou courts in cooperation with courts in other regions in talent training, education and training, and business exchanges, and actively cooperate with political and law universities and ethnic universities to carry out special training for bilingual judges. Strengthen regular talent exchanges with Party and government agencies and universities, and increase the coverage of mutual assignment training.

18. Build a red court culture brand. Comprehensively sort out the development context of the courts, deeply summarize the red judicial genes, and continuously enrich the connotation of red court culture. Support Guizhou courts in comprehensively upgrading cultural education positions, and build a number of court cultural positions with distinctive features, prominent themes, and significant influence in courts across the country. Adapt to the development trend of the times, actively create a number of high-quality red court cultural works with novel forms, strong artistry, and rich content, and comprehensively use "newspapers, networks, mobile terminals, microblogs, screens" and other multimedia communication methods to strengthen publicity, and enhance the communication, guidance, and influence of red court culture. Flexibly use folk songs, micro-videos, and other forms to create legal culture works that are popular among ethnic minority groups and the vast rural grassroots masses.

19. Strengthen grassroots foundation building. Adhere to the orientation of strengthening the grassroots, improve the personnel management mechanism, promote the allocation of judge posts to the grassroots and the front line of case handling, establish a normalized rotation mechanism, strengthen trial support personnel, and encourage standardized and orderly procurement of social services. Reform and optimize the layout of people's tribunals, improve the management and guarantee mechanisms of people's tribunals, strengthen the team, equipment, and information technology construction of people's tribunals, and better leverage the role of people's tribunals in grassroots social governance. Support Guizhou courts in relying on the Guizhou political and legal organs' cross-departmental big data case handling platform, comprehensively deepen and promote paperless case handling and office work, actively explore and summarize demonstration application scenarios of judicial blockchain and judicial artificial intelligence, and deepen the construction of smart courts.

20. Strengthen organizational leadership. Relevant units of the Supreme People's Court should strengthen line guidance, and the Fifth Circuit Court of the Supreme People's Court should fully leverage the convenience of its stationing, and create a favorable legal environment by adjudicating cases in accordance with the law. The Guizhou High People's Court should fully and accurately implement the spirit of the relevant documents of the Party Central Committee, strengthen responsibility and accountability, consolidate the main responsibility, clarify goals and tasks, strengthen supervision and guidance, and pay close attention to the implementation of work. Intermediate and grassroots people's courts in Guizhou Province should, based on the actual economic and social development of each region, refine and improve service and guarantee measures, and ensure that various service and guarantee measures are effectively implemented and produce results.

October 11, 2022
